notes.title: Hotfix 1.01
notes.content:
Patch Notes:

[list]
[*] Increased supplies earned from citizen activity in supply center from 50 to 60.
[*] Reduced Enemy troop size in the battle for the Holy City. 
[*] Fixed an issue where text pertaining to passive ability unlocks were not being showcased. 
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.96
notes.content:
[b]Update 0.96:[/b]

Patch Notes-

[list]
[*] Added a stats screen summarizing a run. 
[*] Fixed a bug which prevented persistent rewards from unlocking.
[*] Made some balance changes to combat and events.
[*] Text boxes in visual novel scenes can now be hidden.
[*] Other minor bug fixes.
[/list]


[b]Expect a full release next week!
[/b]

notes.title: The Last Bastion Pre-release build - 0.9112
notes.content:
Update 0.9112:

This will be our final content update in early access. We are planning a full launch, pretty soon.
This update makes the game playable from start to finish. Future early access updates will only have balance and bug fixes.

Features-

[list]
[*] Added 2 new maps with new events and plot-lines.
[*] Added Hazards in battles
[*] Added new passive abilities to companion commanders.
[*] Added global abilities that can be used in battle.
[*] Overhauled the entire User Interface.
[*] Added a new scouting mechanic.
[*] Reworked the balance
[*] Added 6 endings.
[*] Added new persistent rewards
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.4.61 - Hotfix
notes.content:
[b]Hotfix 0.4.61:[/b]

Patch Notes-

Fixed a bug preventing progress through the tutorial if a commander is not assigned to the right slot.

Fixed a bug where players are unable to navigate through nodes in the first province after finishing the tutorial.


[b]Expect a major update next week!
[/b]

notes.title: Update 0.4.37
notes.content:
[b]Update 0.4.37:[/b]

This update adds a playable tutorial to the game and reworks the balance of the game. 

[b]CHANGELOG:[/b]

[b]TUTORIAL[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a playable Tutorial.
[/list]

[b]COMBAT[/b]
[list]
[*] Battleslot capture timer is now visible in deployment phase.
[*] Added a few more battles in the second province.
[*] Rebalanced all battles.
[/list]

[b]OTHERS[/b]
[list]
[*] Rebalanced the rewards given in Events.
[*] UI Improvements.
[*] Changed Building upgrade prices.
[/list]

[b]BUG FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where certain forced and follow up Events were breaking the game.
[*] Fixed A.P regeneration in combat to correctly factor in morale.
[*] Fixed incorrect display of choices in certain Events.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 0.3.1.2
notes.content:
Bug-fixes for issues encountered in build 0.3.1.

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where Tavern upgrades were not working as intended.
[*] Fixed the issue where Elephant HP is incorrectly displayed as 3.
[*] Fixed an issue where persistent rewards for finishing the second map was not unlocking for some players.
[*] Fixed an issue where retreat was not appropriately deducting supplies and renown.
[*] Pikemen are now weak against Light Infantry.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.3.1
notes.content:
[b]Update 0.3.1:[/b]

This update comprises of gameplay tweaks, QOL improvements and bug fixes.  Details are listed below-

[b]CHANGELOG[/b]

COMBAT
[list]
[*] A non-deployed playable commander can replace a defeated playable commander in the time frame the enemy takes to capture the battle slot.
[*] Pause button has been reworked to make it more visually indicative.
[*] Added one new recruit able commander - Nyasa.
[*] Added passive ability "Archer volley" for Commander Nyasa.
[*] Added passive ability "Mounted Alacrity" for Commander Hazzar.
[/list]

IMPROVEMENTS
[list]
[*] Reworked weather effect - 'fog' for camp and map.
[*] Fog density varies from day to day.
[*] Changed province 2 map visual.
[*] Changed map icons.
[*] Changed player representative flag on map.
[*] Added varied visual states for player representative flag based on morale value.
[*] Added additional game-over screens for certain scenarios.
[*] Updated player sprites appearing in the command tent.
[*] Added a scroll bar to the event window.
[*] Changed back-end processing of persistent rewards.
[/list]

BUG FIXES
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where archer flank attack animations trigger even after their death.
[*] Fixed incorrect battle data being showcased for enemies in a few battles.
[*] Fixed an issue with civilian supply consumption displaying incorrect value in the supply center.
[*] Fixed rewards in certain events not being displayed correctly.
[/list]

Next week's update will focus on a playable tutorial.
